summary: Evaluate authority from agent role, task scope, risk and fresh exact-SHA evidence. CI success satisfies only its technical sub-gate.

stages.gate: Registered identity, role, task, parent run, correlation id, repository, branch, allowed paths and expiry; unknown identities are read-only.
Changed paths, data sensitivity, financial/production impact, reversibility and blast radius classified; unresolved classification is high risk.
Required workflows/tests pass on exact current SHA; no skipped, cancelled, neutral, missing, stale or untrusted required check; provenance and artifact digests recorded.
Reviewer is distinct from author/requester/agent, qualified for risk, repository-authorized and approved exact current SHA; unresolved critical/high findings block.

Financial changes require independent financial review, real PostgreSQL evidence, accounting invariants, reconciliation, finality/reorg behavior and bounded exposure. Other changes require relevant domain acceptance.
Required for production release, production-secret policy, financial execution/acceptance, high-risk merge exceptions or permission changes; explicit, scoped, time-bounded and exact-SHA-bound.
Policy engine issues only minimum capability whose gates passed; grants are task-bound, short-lived, audited and revocable. HERMES cannot approve own escalation.
Monitor expiry, evidence invalidation, policy drift, incidents, failed health checks and usage limits; revoke automatically and audit reason.

requirements: B1-B5 merged and exact-SHA verifier pass
active branch protection requires CI, independent review and up-to-date branch
qualified independent approval on exact head SHA
no unresolved review, conflicts or protected-path changes

tracking.audit: Append-only; fail closed if recording a grant, approval, revocation or authority decision fails.

fail_closed_conditions: required check skipped, cancelled, neutral or absent

rules.ci_semantics: CI success satisfies only the CI evidence predicate for the exact SHA; it never grants universal acceptance or unrestricted permissions.
rules.no_self_graduation: An agent cannot request, review, approve or issue its own authority escalation.
rules.no_self_acceptance: The builder does not perform independent QA, security or financial acceptance on its own work.
rules.evidence_invalidation: Any changed head SHA invalidates downstream approvals and requires re-evaluation.
rules.grant_lifecycle: Every grant is least-privilege, task-scoped, short-lived, revocable and append-only audited.
rules.production_default: Production deployment and raw production-secret access remain disabled for agents until separate protected policies are implemented and explicitly enabled.
rules.financial_default: Unrestricted financial operations are prohibited; bounded capabilities require financial acceptance and explicit scoped authorization.
rules.rollout: Observe-only first; do not issue permissions until enforcement tests prove evaluator and policy engine.
